purpose: Audit whether reducing fixed GPU model footprint can free enough VRAM to reopen exact hot up/down compute without violating the accepted 16GB cold-start constraints.

accepted_sota.config: vendor DeepSeek, strict cold drop_caches, MemoryMax=16000000000, MemorySwapMax=0, cpu_moe=40, gate-only one-stream O_DIRECT pack, GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_CACHE_MIB=13568, prefill_limit=3000, -c 256 -b 16 -ub 16 -t 20 -tb 20

source_semantics.n_cpu_moe: common/arg.cpp defines --n-cpu-moe as keeping the MoE weights of the first N layers on CPU.
source_semantics.ngl: src/llama-model.cpp places GPU layers back-to-front; lowering -ngl moves dense/attention repeating layers from GPU to CPU.
source_semantics.fit: common/fit.cpp first evaluates all-MoE-on-CPU dense placement, then fills dense-only layers back-to-front and may convert dense-only layers to full layers when surplus exists.

historical_footprint_evidence.name: cpu39_cache10496_profile_admission
historical_footprint_evidence.decision: rejected; one fewer CPU MoE layer increases GPU model by about 3264 MiB and forces smaller gate cache.

historical_footprint_evidence.name: cpu38_vram10_tradeoff
historical_footprint_evidence.decision: rejected; moving more MoE layers to GPU consumes VRAM and collapses the gate-cache path.

historical_footprint_evidence.name: cpu41_vram14_gate_cache_tradeoff
historical_footprint_evidence.decision: rejected as a pure gate-cache tradeoff; it freed one expert layer but added CPU fallback and only reached 1.6 tok/s in the old path.

historical_footprint_evidence.name: cpu41_cache14336_t24_nowarmup
historical_footprint_evidence.decision: rejected as a pure gate-cache/thread/no-warmup variant.

historical_footprint_evidence.name: warm_cache_cpu39_old_result_not_accepted
historical_footprint_evidence.decision: not an accepted cold-start SOTA. Same vram2 family later cold-profile reruns with drop_caches reached only 1.2-1.3 tok/s and recorded file page-cache pressure.

dense_attention_ngl_bound.candidate: lower -ngl to move dense/attention layers from GPU to CPU
dense_attention_ngl_bound.freed_vram_per_layer_mib_estimate: about 136-166 MiB dense tensors per layer from GGUF tensor scan
dense_attention_ngl_bound.useful_target_mib: at least 1632-2176 MiB for top384/top512 hot residual, preferably 3264 MiB for top768
dense_attention_ngl_bound.reason: Moving 14-16 dense/attention layers to CPU would add CPU attention/dense matmul on many decode layers while current 10 tok/s budget has only about 1642.887 ms total overhead after full fallback removal. It also risks TTFT and page-cache pressure. No existing accepted evidence shows dense/attention CPU placement can preserve the current 4.4 tok/s line, let alone support 10 tok/s.

cpu41_reopened_candidate.candidate: cpu41 plus exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 hot residual up/down residency
cpu41_reopened_candidate.why_reopened: cpu41 frees about one expert layer, 3264 MiB, without reducing gate-cache capacity. This is enough for a top768 hot residual up/down payload at 4.25 MiB per tensor/expert slot.
cpu41_reopened_candidate.correctness_gate: Any exact Q8_0 CUDA hot-residual implementation must pass fixed-text token-level top1 verification before a strict cold France benchmark. Prior scalar Q8_0 probe failed same_top1=136/145, so this is a real blocker.
cpu41_reopened_candidate.ram_gate: All runs must keep MemoryMax=16000000000 and MemorySwapMax=0; source/hotset preparation must not put the 145.42 GiB model into host page cache.
cpu41_reopened_candidate.ttft_gate: Accepted TTFT must remain <= 33617.688744 ms. A diagnostic may be recorded as rejected if TTFT exceeds the gate, but cannot be promoted.

next_required_work.plan_update: Add a concrete design step for cpu41 + top768 exact Q8_0 hot residual residency before runtime code.
implementation_preconditions: Define a default-off hot residual cache that uses the 3264 MiB freed by cpu41 without reducing the accepted gate cache.
Implement or prototype exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 CUDA arithmetic close to CPU fallback semantics.
Run the fixed-text token-level top1 verifier before any performance benchmark.
Only then run a strict cold diagnostic under 16GB cgroup with full memory/page-cache accounting.
reject_if: implementation overhead exceeds the 446 ms best-case budget before other effects
host RAM including file cache exceeds 16GB or swap is used
TTFT exceeds the accepted gate for a promoted result
France answer is not semantic, coherent, and complete
